versions.content: A list of possible port configurations for the structure Port_ConfigType is given below:  Pin mode (e.g. DIO, ADC, SPI …) – this port pin configuration is mandatory unless the port pin is configured for DIO.  Pin direction (input, output) – this port pin configuration is mandatory when the port pin is to be used for DIO.  Pin level init value (see SWS_Port_00055) – this port pin configuration is mandatory when the port pin is used for DIO.  Pin direction changeable during runtime (STD_ON/STD_OFF) – this port pin configuration is MCU dependent.  Pin mode changeable during runtime (STD_ON/STD_OFF) – configuration is MCU dependent. Optional parameters (if supported by hardware)  Slew rate control.  Activation of internal pull-ups.  Microcontroller specific port pin properties.
